title: "Reconcile Sectorization and Construct Healthsheds"
subtitle: "Implement legacy stage 5 as ordered spatial targets"
execute:

engine: markdown
---

This page implements pinned legacy stage 5 at
`31e0769683e133e136b09ac0c6608c5a12657a9a`. Each reviewed correction round is a
separate target. Shared FKT assignments, population accounting, missing-value
behavior, join multiplicity, and residual non-contiguity retain legacy rules.
Spatial handoffs are ordinary `sf` targets; nonspatial exports use Parquet.
The execution page tangles these declarations without executing scientific
code during rendering.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Require The Reviewed Inputs And Spatial Runtime"}

Require the tracked `s2_clinic_months_raw_zip` and
`s1_gesis_xwalk_clean_df`, the rebuilt [native runtime](../infrastructure/13_page-jinja-build.qmd),
and the [package acceptance checks](../infrastructure/14_page-uvr.qmd).
All stage-5 inputs below are exact `data/raw/` members of that tracked archive;
the similarly named `from Symphonia/` sectorization copy is not substituted.
The complete shapefile bundle is extracted privately and read before cleanup.
No raw source or reviewed decision is edited.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Declare Archive, Geometry, And Matching Helpers"}

Helpers are tracked function targets, not an unresolved `source()` call.
The grouped fuzzy join preserves original row identifiers, shared-group
boundaries, cosine distance, callback selection, and ties. The topology helper
uses the legacy DE-9IM positions 1, 2, 4, and 5; point contact alone does not
connect polygons. Relation matrices are decoded directly in R, avoiding a
data-frame mutation for every clinic. Population summation likewise uses
base-R pair deduplication: attaching duckplyr replaces `unique.data.frame()`,
which would otherwise execute a DuckDB query for each clinic group. As in the legacy script, `st_relate()`
uses planar DE-9IM on the source longitude/latitude coordinates; its repeated
informational notice is suppressed, while errors and warnings propagate.
Empty healthsheds are constructed with the input CRS.

```{r}
s5_healthshed_drop_geometry_fn <- function(x) {
  x <- as.data.frame(x)
  x[!vapply(x, inherits, logical(1), what = "sfc")]
}
s5_healthshed_runtime_fn <- function() {
  packages <- c("sf", "s2", "units", "igraph", "fuzzyjoin", "stringdist", "dplyr")
  list(R = as.character(getRversion()),
       packages = setNames(vapply(packages, function(x) as.character(utils::packageVersion(x)), character(1)), packages),
       engines = sf::sf_extSoftVersion(), s2 = sf::sf_use_s2(),
       native_lock_md5 = if (file.exists("/opt/spack-environment/spack.lock"))
         unname(tools::md5sum("/opt/spack-environment/spack.lock")) else NA_character_)
}
s5_healthshed_read_fn <- function(archive, members, name, kind = "csv", colClasses = NULL, ...) {
  s3_dictionary_archive_read_fn(archive, members[[name]], function(path) {
    if (kind == "xlsx") return(readxl::read_excel(path, ...))
    if (kind == "rds") return(readRDS(path))
    columns <- names(read.csv(path, nrows = 0L, fileEncoding = "UTF-8"))
    ids <- columns[grepl("uid|instat|code|pcode", columns, ignore.case = TRUE)]
    if (is.null(colClasses)) colClasses <- setNames(rep("character", length(ids)), ids)
    read.csv(path, colClasses = colClasses,
             fileEncoding = "UTF-8", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, ...)
  })
}
s5_healthshed_shapes_read_fn <- function(archive, members) {
  unsafe <- startsWith(members, "/") | vapply(strsplit(members, "/", fixed = TRUE), function(x) any(x == ".."), logical(1))
  stopifnot(length(members) >= 4L, !any(unsafe))
  required <- c("shp", "shx", "dbf", "prj")
  stopifnot(all(required %in% tools::file_ext(members)))
  scratch <- tempfile("healthshed-shapes-")
  dir.create(scratch)
  on.exit(unlink(scratch, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  paths <- utils::unzip(archive, files = members, exdir = scratch)
  stopifnot(all(file.exists(paths)))
  sf::read_sf(paths[endsWith(paths, ".shp")])
}
s5_healthshed_adjacency_fn <- function(x, y = x) {
  # st_relate uses planar DE-9IM even for geographic coordinates, as in stage 5.
  relation <- suppressMessages(sf::st_relate(x, y))
  matrix(grepl("1|2", paste0(substr(relation, 1, 2), substr(relation, 4, 5))),
         nrow = length(x), ncol = length(y))
}
s5_healthshed_components_fn <- function(x) {
  if (!length(x)) return(0L)
  igraph::components(igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(s5_healthshed_adjacency_fn(x)), mode = "weak")$no
}
s5_grouped_stringdist_fulljoin_fn <- function(df1, df2, df1_group, df2_group,
    df1_stringmatch, df2_stringmatch, dist_method = "cosine", dist_col = "dist",
    max_dist = 30, ignore_case = TRUE, select_match = identity, unnest = TRUE, ...) {
  left <- as.data.frame(df1) %>% mutate(df1_id = seq_len(n())) %>% nest_by(across(all_of(df1_group)), .key = "df1")
  right <- as.data.frame(df2) %>% mutate(df2_id = seq_len(n())) %>% nest_by(across(all_of(df2_group)), .key = "df2")
  # Legacy full_join + removal of absent nested groups keeps shared groups only.
  joined <- inner_join(left, right, by = setNames(df2_group, df1_group)) %>%
    rowwise() %>% mutate(df_new = list(select_match(fuzzyjoin::stringdist_join(
      df1, df2, by = setNames(df2_stringmatch, df1_stringmatch), mode = "full",
      method = dist_method, distance_col = dist_col, max_dist = max_dist,
      ignore_case = ignore_case, ...))))
  if (unnest) joined <- joined %>% select(-df1, -df2) %>% tidyr::unnest(df_new)
  joined
}
s5_healthshed_refresh_fn <- function(x, lookup, shapes, fallback = FALSE) {
  x <- s5_healthshed_drop_geometry_fn(x)
  previous <- if (fallback && "ADM4_PCODE" %in% names(x)) x$ADM4_PCODE else rep(NA_character_, nrow(x))
  x$ADM4_PCODE <- NULL
  x$.s5_previous_pcode <- previous
  x <- left_join(x, select(lookup, ADM4C_BNGRC, ADM4_PCODE), by = c("fkt_instat_clean" = "ADM4C_BNGRC"))
  if (fallback) x$ADM4_PCODE <- coalesce(x$ADM4_PCODE, x$.s5_previous_pcode)
  x$.s5_previous_pcode <- NULL
  x <- left_join(x, as.data.frame(select(shapes, ADM4_PCODE)), by = "ADM4_PCODE")
  sf::st_as_sf(x)
}
```

```{r}
s5_healthshed_aggregate_fn <- function(sect_df){
  empty_geom <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_geometrycollection(), crs = sf::st_crs(sect_df))
  sect_df %>%
    filter(!(is.na(fkt_uid) | fkt_uid == "" | is.na(fkt_name) | fkt_name == "")) %>% #pull(fs_uid) %>% n_distinct()
    sf::st_as_sf() %>%
    group_by(fs_uid) %>%
    # for each clinic, merge the shapefiles
    summarise(# since some fkt_uid get matched twice, have to take only unique ones
      # before summing the population
      fs_pop = sum(fkt_pop_2022[!duplicated(data.frame(
        fkt_uid = fkt_uid, fkt_pop_2022 = fkt_pop_2022))], na.rm = TRUE),
      n_fkt_uid = n_distinct(fkt_uid, na.rm = T),
      n_fkt_instat = n_distinct(fkt_instat_clean, na.rm = T),
      across(c(region_uid:district_name,
               starts_with("fs"),
               n_fkt_instat, n_fkt_uid),
             function(x){unique(na.omit(x))}),
      # recalculate the number of components
      n_components = {if(n_distinct(fkt_instat_clean, na.rm = T) > 0){
        s5_healthshed_components_fn(geometry[!is.na(fkt_instat_clean)])} else{0}},
              geometry = {if(n_distinct(fkt_instat_clean, na.rm = T) > 0){
                sf::st_union(geometry[!is.na(fkt_instat_clean)]) %>%
                  sf::st_combine() %>%
                  sf::st_make_valid()} else {empty_geom}}) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(n_shape = length(geometry[[1]])) %>%
    ungroup
}
```

::: {.manual-procedure title="Select Exact Archived Sources And Record The Geometry Environment"}

The execution page records `s5_spatial_runtime_list` with an always-check
cue. Its unchanged value lets downstream targets skip; changed package,
engine, or topology settings invalidate the spatial read. It does not change
the global s2 setting or projection.

```{r}
s5_healthshed_archive_members_list <- {
  suffixes <- c(
    lookup = "data/raw/bngrc_codes_lut_pcodes_2018.xlsx",
    sectorization = "data/raw/mapping GESIS DHIS questions - FKT code instat.csv",
    duplicates = "data/raw/symphonia_verified/VERIFIER duplicated_fkt_instat_in_sectorisation2022.csv",
    match1 = "data/raw/symphonia_verified/VERIFIER fkt_name_matching_for_sectorisation2022.csv",
    manual1 = "data/raw/symphonia_verified/FKT SECTO UNMATCHED.xlsx",
    manual2 = "data/raw/geolocation/manual_fkt_match.csv",
    match2 = "data/raw/symphonia_verified/VERIFIER fkt_name_matching_for_sectorisation2022_v2.csv",
    match3 = "data/raw/symphonia_verified/VERIFIER fkt_name_matching_for_sectorisation2022_v3.csv",
    sectorization2018 = "data/raw/sectorisation 2018.xlsx",
    manual3 = "data/raw/geolocation/manual_fkt_match_v2.csv",
    manual4 = "data/raw/geolocation/manual_fkt_match_v3.csv",
    unmatch = "data/raw/geolocation/unmatch_fkt.csv",
    districts = "data/raw/geolocation/sect_ocha_district_match.rds",
    final_reviews = "data/raw/from Symphonia/Verification secto vs ocha.xlsx",
    reassignments = "data/raw/symphonia_verified/noncontig_v2_fix.csv")
  tables <- vapply(suffixes, function(suffix) s3_dictionary_archive_member_fn(s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, suffix), character(1))
  names <- utils::unzip(s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, list = TRUE)$Name
  stem <- "data/raw/mdg_adm_bngrc_ocha_20181031_shp/mdg_admbnda_adm4_BNGRC_OCHA_20181031."
  shapes <- names[grepl(stem, names, fixed = TRUE) & !grepl("(^|/)__MACOSX/", names)]
  stopifnot(length(shapes) > 0L, !anyDuplicated(basename(shapes)))
  list(tables = tables, shapes = shapes)
}
s5_fkt_shapes_source_sf <- {
  s5_spatial_runtime_list
  s5_healthshed_shapes_read_fn(s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s5_healthshed_archive_members_list$shapes)
}
s5_fkt_shapes_valid_sf <- sf::st_make_valid(s5_fkt_shapes_source_sf)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Split Nosy Mitsio And Reconcile Population"}

The initial split retains the source's first-polygon versus remaining-parts
rule. Part order, bounds, areas, source CRS, and library versions are recorded
in the split audit. A synthetic test makes the order dependency explicit.
Population merging uses the reviewed notes and the source's sum/NA semantics;
shared assignments are not deduplicated across clinics.

```{r}
s5_fkt_shapes_initial_sf <- {
  fkt_shape <- s5_fkt_shapes_valid_sf
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 61–74.
  fkt_shape <- rbind(fkt_shape %>%
                       filter(ADM4_PCODE != "MG71717150005"),
                     fkt_shape %>%
                       filter(ADM4_PCODE == "MG71717150005") %>%
                       sf::st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
                       mutate(group = (seq_len(n())) > 1) %>%
                       summarise(across(!geometry, unique),
                                 geometry = sf::st_union(geometry),
                                 .by = group) %>%
                       select(-group) %>%
                       mutate(ADM4_EN = ifelse(seq_len(n()) == 1,
                                               ADM4_EN,
                                               "Nosy Mitsio"),
                              ADM4_PCODE = paste0(ADM4_PCODE, LETTERS[seq_len(n())])))
  fkt_shape
}
```

```{r}
s5_fkt_code_lookup_source_df <- s5_healthshed_read_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s5_healthshed_archive_members_list$tables, "lookup", "xlsx", sheet = 5) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
```

```{r}
s5_fkt_code_lookup_initial_df <- {
  ocha_map <- s5_fkt_code_lookup_source_df
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 80–88.
  ocha_map <- ocha_map %>%
    {rbind(filter(., ADM4_PCODE != "MG71717150005"),
           filter(., ADM4_PCODE == "MG71717150005") %>%
             mutate(across(c(ADM4_PCODE, ADM4C_BNGRC),
                           ~paste0(.x, "A"))),
           filter(., ADM4_PCODE == "MG71717150005") %>%
             mutate(across(c(ADM4_PCODE, ADM4C_BNGRC),

                    ADM4_EN = "Nosy Mitsio",
                    ADM4E_BNGRC = "NOSY MITSIO"))}

}
```

```{r}
s5_sectorization_2022_source_df <- {
  x <- s5_healthshed_read_fn(s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s5_healthshed_archive_members_list$tables, "sectorization", colClasses = "character")
  stopifnot(ncol(x) == 17L)
  names(x) <- c("region_uid", "region_name", "district_uid", "district_name", "commune_uid", "commune_name",
                "fs_uid", "fs_type", "fs_name", "f_or_nf", "geometry", "fkt_uid", "fkt_instat", "fkt_name",
                "fkt_pop_2022", "distance_csb_fkt", "transit")
  x[c("fkt_pop_2022", "distance_csb_fkt", "transit")] <- lapply(x[c("fkt_pop_2022", "distance_csb_fkt", "transit")], type.convert, as.is = TRUE)
  mutate(x, fkt_instat = ifelse(fkt_instat == "717150005", "717150005A", fkt_instat))
}
s5_sectorization_duplicate_reviews_df <- s5_healthshed_read_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s5_healthshed_archive_members_list$tables, "duplicates")
```

```{r}
s5_sectorization_population_reconciled_df <- {
  sect <- s5_sectorization_2022_source_df
  dup_fkt_instat <- s5_sectorization_duplicate_reviews_df
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 111–121.
  sect_filled <- sect %>%
    left_join(dup_fkt_instat %>%
                mutate(fkt_instat = as.character(fkt_instat)) %>%
                select(fkt_uid, fkt_instat, NOTE)) %>%
    group_by(fkt_instat) %>%
    mutate(merge_fkt = any(grepl("keep that row", NOTE)) & any(NOTE == "delete"),
           fkt_pop_2022 = ifelse(merge_fkt, sum(fkt_pop_2022), fkt_pop_2022)) %>%
    ungroup %>%
    filter(!merge_fkt | (merge_fkt & NOTE != "delete")) %>%
    select(-merge_fkt, -NOTE)
  # drops 6 rows --> 21880 to 21874
  sect_filled
}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Apply The Initial Reviewed Matching Rounds"}

The five matching sources are applied in their original precedence. Invalid
original codes are cleared, reviewed one-to-many matches retain multiplicity,
and direct clinic assignments are appended before attaching geometry.

```{r}
s5_sectorization_fkt_match_reviews_list <- {
  read <- function(key, kind = "csv", ...) s5_healthshed_read_fn(
    s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s5_healthshed_archive_members_list$tables, key, kind, ...)
  list(match_check = read("match1") %>% mutate(NOTE = ifelse(fkt_code_instat %in% c("114110001", "513010005", "204230010", "410050001", "713232001"), "no", NOTE)),
       manual_match = read("manual1", "xlsx") %>% select(-`...1`) %>% filter(fkt_code_instat != "305170005"),
       manual2 = read("manual2") %>% mutate(across(starts_with("match"), trimws)) %>% select(-note_reason, -X) %>% unique(),
       match_check_v2 = read("match2"), match_check_v3 = read("match3"))
}
```

```{r}
s5_sectorization_fkt_matches_df <- {
  sect_filled <- s5_sectorization_population_reconciled_df
  ocha_map <- s5_fkt_code_lookup_initial_df
  match_check <- s5_sectorization_fkt_match_reviews_list$match_check
  manual_match <- s5_sectorization_fkt_match_reviews_list$manual_match
  manual2 <- s5_sectorization_fkt_match_reviews_list$manual2
  match_check_v2 <- s5_sectorization_fkt_match_reviews_list$match_check_v2
  match_check_v3 <- s5_sectorization_fkt_match_reviews_list$match_check_v3
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 142–208.
  sect_filled <- sect_filled %>% #pull(fkt_instat) %>% n_distinct(na.rm = T) # 13687
    # remove fkt codes that aren't in the instat/ocha shapefile
    mutate(fkt_instat_clean = ifelse(fkt_instat %in% ocha_map$ADM4C_BNGRC,
                                     fkt_instat,
                                     NA)) %>%
    # pull(fkt_instat_clean) %>% n_distinct(na.rm = T) # 13687 - 19 = 13668 ocha instat codes
    # add the confirmed matches from the first fuzzy string matching
    left_join(match_check %>%
                filter(NOTE == "yes") %>%
                select(fkt_uid, match1 = fkt_code_instat),
              by = "fkt_uid",
              multiple = "all") %>% # nrow
    # this left join adds 30 nrow because some fkt_uid got matched to multiple instat codes
    # 21874 --> 21904
    mutate(fkt_instat_clean = ifelse(is.na(fkt_instat_clean),
                                     match1,
                                     fkt_instat_clean)) %>%
    # pull(fkt_instat_clean) %>% n_distinct(na.rm = T) # + 2536 rows (4 instat fkt are dupliated) --> 162000 instat/ocha codes
    # matches from Symphonia's manual matcing
    left_join(manual_match %>%
                mutate(check = as.numeric(fkt_code_instat)) %>%
                filter(!is.na(check)) %>%
                select(fkt_uid, match2 = fkt_code_instat)) %>%
    mutate(fkt_instat_clean = ifelse(is.na(fkt_instat_clean),
                                     match2,
                                     fkt_instat_clean)) %>%
    # pull(fkt_instat_clean) %>% n_distinct(na.rm = T)  # + 159 rows  --> 16359 instat/ocha codes match
    # confirmed matches from fuzzy string matching v2
    left_join(match_check_v2 %>%
                filter(NOTE == "yes") %>%
                select(fkt_uid, match3 = fkt_code_instat),
              multiple = "all") %>% # nrow
    # this left join adds 14 nrow because some fkt_uid got matched to multiple instat codes
    # 21904 --> 21918
    mutate(fkt_instat_clean = ifelse(is.na(fkt_instat_clean),
                                     match3,
                                     fkt_instat_clean)) %>%
    # pull(fkt_instat_clean) %>% n_distinct(na.rm = T)  # + 722 rows (6 instat codes matched to 2 uid) --> 17075 instat codes matched
    # confirmed matches from fuzzy string matching v3
    left_join(match_check_v3 %>%
                filter(note == "yes") %>%
                select(fkt_uid, match4 = fkt_code_instat),
              multiple = "all") %>% # nrow
    # this left join adds 2 nrow because some fkt_uid got matched to multiple instat codes
    # 21918 --> 21920
    mutate(fkt_instat_clean = ifelse(is.na(fkt_instat_clean),
                                     match4,
                                     fkt_instat_clean)) %>%
    # pull(fkt_instat_clean) %>% n_distinct(na.rm = T)  # + 134 rows (6 instat codes matched to 2 uid) --> 17203 (of 17465 instat fkt matched)
    left_join(manual2 %>%
                filter(match_type == "fkt") %>%
                select(match5 = fkt_instat_code,
                       fkt_uid = match_uid)) %>%
    mutate(fkt_instat_clean = ifelse(is.na(fkt_instat_clean),
                                     match5,
                                     fkt_instat_clean)) %>%
    # pull(fkt_instat_clean) %>% n_distinct(na.rm = T)  # --> 17264 (of 17465 instat fkt matched)
    rename(fkt_instat_orig = fkt_instat,
           fs_ll = geometry) %>%
    mutate(match_type = case_when(fkt_instat_clean == fkt_instat_orig ~ "original",
                                  fkt_instat_clean == match1 ~ "fuzzy1",
                                  fkt_instat_clean == match2 ~ "manual",
                                  fkt_instat_clean == match3 ~ "fuzzy2",
                                  fkt_instat_clean == match4 ~ "fuzzy3",
                                  fkt_instat_clean == match5 ~ "manual2")) %>%
    select(-(match1:match5))
  # now 21920 rows x 19 col
  sect_filled
}
```

```{r}

  sect_filled <- sect_filled %>% full_join(manual2 %>%

}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Evaluate Topology And Build Initial Healthsheds"}

Isolated assignments are unlinked only when the legacy component-count rule
holds; `manual2` assignments remain protected. Components and the legacy
`n_shape` field are retained separately. No generic disjointness requirement
is imposed on healthsheds.

```{r}
s5_sectorization_initial_topology_sf <- {
  sect_filled <- s5_sectorization_initial_geometry_sf
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 233–259.
  sect_filled <- sect_filled %>%
    group_by(fs_uid) %>%
    mutate(n_fkt_instat = n_distinct(fkt_instat_clean, na.rm = T),
           n_adj_fkt = {if(first(n_fkt_instat) == 0) {NA} else{
             rowSums(s5_healthshed_adjacency_fn(geometry)) - 1}},
           n_components = {if(first(n_fkt_instat) == 0) {NA} else{
             s5_healthshed_components_fn(geometry[!is.na(ADM4_PCODE)])}},
           drop_solo = (sum(n_adj_fkt == 0) == 1) &
             (sum(n_adj_fkt > 0) > 1) &
             n_components == 2)
  sect_filled
}
```

```{r}
s5_sectorization_contiguity_filtered_sf <- {
  sect_filled <- s5_sectorization_initial_topology_sf
  fkt_shape <- s5_fkt_shapes_initial_sf
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 264–275.
  sect_filled <- sect_filled %>%
    ungroup %>%
    mutate(fkt_instat_matched = fkt_instat_clean,
           fkt_instat_clean = case_when(drop_solo & n_adj_fkt == 0 & match_type != "manual2" ~ NA,
                                          T ~ fkt_instat_clean),
           ADM4_PCODE = case_when(drop_solo & n_adj_fkt == 0 & match_type != "manual2" ~ NA,
                                  T ~ ADM4_PCODE)) %>%
    # drop, then rejoin the geometry to remove the geometries for the ones you want to unmatch
    s5_healthshed_drop_geometry_fn() %>%
    left_join(fkt_shape %>% select(ADM4_PCODE))

  sf::st_as_sf(sect_filled, sf_column_name = "geometry")
}
```

```{r}
s5_healthshed_clinic_initial_sf <- s5_healthshed_aggregate_fn(s5_sectorization_contiguity_filtered_sf)
s5_fkt_unmatched_initial_sf <- s5_fkt_shapes_initial_sf %>%
  filter(!ADM4_PCODE %in% s5_sectorization_contiguity_filtered_sf$ADM4_PCODE) %>%
  left_join(select(s5_fkt_code_lookup_initial_df, ADM4_PCODE, ADM4C_BNGRC), by = "ADM4_PCODE")
s5_sectorization_2018_source_df <- s5_healthshed_read_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s5_healthshed_archive_members_list$tables, "sectorization2018", "xlsx", skip = 2) %>%
  rename_with(function(x) gsub(" ", "_", x)) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  mutate(row_id = seq_len(n())) %>% select(-(`Population_totale_année_2018/FKT`:`0.076`))
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Recover Historical Assignments And Apply Follow-Up Reviews"}

The historical bridge reuses the cleaned 2018 GESIS mapping. Candidate
geometry and adjacency evidence precede the grouped minimum-distance match;
ties and the inclusive cosine cutoff `<= 0.11` are preserved. Follow-up manual
unmatches are applied before manual fills, and geometry is refreshed.

```{r}
s5_sectorization_2018_candidates_sf <- {
  sect2018 <- s5_sectorization_2018_source_df
  mapping <- s1_gesis_xwalk_clean_df
  unmatched_fkt <- s5_fkt_unmatched_initial_sf
  ocha_map <- s5_fkt_code_lookup_initial_df
  sheds <- s5_healthshed_clinic_initial_sf
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 318–347.
  matches2018 <- sect2018 %>%
    # add clinic UID to the 2018 sect
    left_join(mapping %>%
                filter(cAnnee == "2018") %>%
                transmute(code_fs = as.character(code_fs),
                          fs_uid),
              by = c("Code_GESIS" = "code_fs")) %>%
    # join in the unmatched fkt so we can limit to those
    left_join(unmatched_fkt %>%
                left_join(ocha_map %>%
                            select(ADM4_PCODE, ADM4C_BNGRC)) %>%
                select(ADM4C_BNGRC, ADM4_EN, ADM2_EN, ADM1_EN),
              by = c("Code_Fkt_BNGRC" = "ADM4C_BNGRC")) %>%
    # limit to unmatched BNGRC codes
    filter(!is.na(ADM4_EN)) %>%
    select(-(`Statut_(Pub_ou_Privé)`:`Accessibilté\n(nb_mois_par_an)`)) %>%
    rename(fkt_geometry = geometry) %>%
    # add on the fs geometry so we can plot them together
    left_join(sheds %>% rename(shed_geometry = geometry))

  matches2018 <- matches2018 %>%
    rowwise %>%
    mutate(relate_str = sf::st_relate(fkt_geometry, shed_geometry),
           fkt_adj = relate_str %>%
             {paste0(str_sub(., 1,2),
                     str_sub(., 4,5))} %>%
             grepl(pattern = "1|2")) %>%
    ungroup %>%
    # also add on information about which of the fs aren't in the healsheds geom
    mutate(no_shed = fs_uid %in% sheds$fs_uid == FALSE)
  sf::st_as_sf(matches2018, sf_column_name = "fkt_geometry")
}
```

```{r}
s5_sectorization_2018_matches_sf <- {
  matches2018 <- as.data.frame(s5_sectorization_2018_candidates_sf)
  sect_filled <- as.data.frame(s5_sectorization_contiguity_filtered_sf)
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 349–369.
  matches2018_in2022 <- matches2018 %>%
    filter(fkt_adj | no_shed) %>%
    filter(!is.na(fs_uid)) %>% #pull(fs_uid) %>% n_distinct 56 potential matches
    select(fs_uid, Code_GESIS, ends_with("geometry"), no_shed, n_components,
           Nom_Fokontany_par_CSB, Code_Fkt_BNGRC) %>%
    distinct %>%
    # join information about which have a close-ish string match in that fs_uid in 2022 sect
    {left_join(.,
               s5_grouped_stringdist_fulljoin_fn(select(., fs_uid, Nom_Fokontany_par_CSB),
                                           sect_filled %>%
                                             filter(is.na(fkt_instat_clean)) %>%
                                             select(fkt_instat_clean, fs_uid, fkt_uid,
                                                    fkt_name2022 = fkt_name,
                                                    commune_name, district_name) %>%
                                             mutate(sect2022 = T),
                                           "fs_uid", "fs_uid",
                                           "Nom_Fokontany_par_CSB", "fkt_name2022",
                                           select_match = (function(df) {group_by(df, df1_id) %>%
                                               filter(dist == min(dist))})) %>%
                 filter(dist <= 0.11) %>%
                 mutate(good_match = T))}
  sf::st_as_sf(matches2018_in2022, sf_column_name = "fkt_geometry")
}
```

```{r}
s5_sectorization_historical_filled_sf <- {

                # filter(fs_uid %in% c("MrABDSyBJVd", "MXZMrSow5Oo",

                                     match_sect2018,
```

```{r}
s5_sectorization_reviewed_v2_sf <- {
```

::: {.manual-procedure title="Evaluate Commune Matches With The Contiguity Guard"}

Closest-commune ties are preserved. A candidate must have one clinic and
distance `< 0.075`; accepted additions must not worsen the component count.
The candidate and rejection evidence remains available independently of the
accepted assignment table.

```{r}
s5_sectorization_commune_candidates_sf <- {
  unmatched_fkt2 <- as.data.frame(s5_fkt_unmatched_v2_sf)
  district_map <- s5_sectorization_district_lookup_df
  sect_filled_v2 <- as.data.frame(s5_sectorization_reviewed_v2_sf)
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 484–503.
  fkt_to_fs_by_commune <- unmatched_fkt2 %>%
    left_join(district_map %>% select(ADM2_PCODE, district_uid)) %>%
    s5_grouped_stringdist_fulljoin_fn(sect_filled_v2 %>%
                                  filter(!is.na(fkt_name) & fkt_name != "") %>%
                                  group_by(commune_uid) %>%
                                  summarise(n_fs = n_distinct(fs_uid, na.rm = T),
                                            across(starts_with("fs"),
                                                   first),
                                            across(c(region_uid:district_name,
                                                     commune_name),
                                                   unique)),
                                df1_group = "district_uid",
                                df2_group = "district_uid",
                                df1_stringmatch = "ADM3_EN",
                                df2_stringmatch = "commune_name") %>%
    group_by(df1_id) %>%
    filter(dist == min(dist)) %>%
    filter(n_fs == 1) %>%
    filter(dist < 0.075)
  sf::st_as_sf(fkt_to_fs_by_commune, sf_column_name = "geometry")
}
```

```{r}
s5_sectorization_commune_topology_sf <- {
  fkt_to_fs_by_commune <- as.data.frame(s5_sectorization_commune_candidates_sf)
  sheds_v2 <- s5_healthshed_clinic_v2_sf
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 506–529.
  by_commune_adj <- fkt_to_fs_by_commune %>%
    ungroup %>%
    select(fkt_code = ADM4_PCODE,
           fkt_geometry = geometry, fs_uid) %>%
    left_join(sheds_v2 %>% select(fs_uid, geometry, n_components)) %>%
    rename(fs_geometry = geometry) %>%
    pivot_longer(ends_with("geometry"),
                 names_to = "type",
                 values_to = "geometry") %>%
    mutate(type = gsub("_geometry", "", type)) %>%
    select(-fkt_code) %>%
    unique %>%
    group_by(fs_uid) %>%
    mutate(n_comp_new = s5_healthshed_components_fn(geometry),
           type = ifelse(n_comp_new > n_components & type == "fkt", "bad", type))
  sf::st_as_sf(by_commune_adj, sf_column_name = "geometry")
}
```

```{r}
s5_sectorization_commune_filled_sf <- {
  sect_filled_v2 <- as.data.frame(s5_sectorization_reviewed_v2_sf)
  fkt_to_fs_by_commune <- as.data.frame(s5_sectorization_commune_candidates_sf)
  by_commune_adj <- as.data.frame(s5_sectorization_commune_topology_sf)
  ocha_map <- s5_fkt_code_lookup_initial_df
  fkt_shape <- s5_fkt_shapes_initial_sf
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 540–563.
  sect_filled_v3 <- sect_filled_v2 %>%
    full_join(fkt_to_fs_by_commune %>%
                ungroup %>%
                left_join(by_commune_adj %>%
                            transmute(fs_uid,
                                      keep = (n_comp_new <= n_components)) %>%
                            unique) %>%
                filter(keep) %>%
                mutate(fkt_uid = "none",
                       match_type = "commune") %>%
                left_join(ocha_map %>% select(ADM4_PCODE, ADM4C_BNGRC)) %>%
                select(starts_with(c("region", "district", "commune", "fs")),
                       match_type,
                       fkt_uid, fkt_name = ADM4_EN,
                       fkt_instat_clean = ADM4C_BNGRC))
  # should just add rows because there's nothing to join to --> 22027 + 117 = 22144

  # also re-fill in the ADM4_PCODE and fkt geometry for everything
  sect_filled_v3 <- sect_filled_v3 %>%
    select(-c(ADM4_PCODE, geometry, n_components)) %>%
    left_join(ocha_map %>% select(ADM4C_BNGRC, ADM4_PCODE),
              by = c("fkt_instat_clean" = "ADM4C_BNGRC")) %>%
    left_join(fkt_shape %>% select(ADM4_PCODE))
  sf::st_as_sf(sect_filled_v3, sf_column_name = "geometry")
}
```

::: {.manual-procedure title="Apply Reviewed Reassignments And Administrative Corrections"}

The reviewed workbook's duplicate header names, hard-coded corrections, and
join keys retain their legacy meaning. Each round consumes the previous
round's state; full joins retain reviewed additions and shared assignments.

```{r}
s5_sectorization_noncontiguous_reviews_df <- {
  sect_filled_v3 <- as.data.frame(s5_sectorization_commune_filled_sf)
  sect_filled <- as.data.frame(s5_sectorization_contiguity_filtered_sf)
  noncontig_fixes <- s5_sectorization_final_reviews_df %>%
# and finally, remove the lines with those fkt from the sect_filled_v3 and add these in
  filter(note...21 == "noncontig_healthsheds") %>%
  # one fkt gets incorrectly moved to a different fs, just drop that row
  filter(fkt_uid != "kJgR66aF9g6") %>%
  # one fix we discussed didn't get added to the xlsx file, so lets fix it manually here
  mutate(fs_uid = case_when(fkt_uid == "NWtrDDpi5n0" ~ "rmlBT17TlZ3",
                            T ~ fs_uid)) %>%
  select(fs_uid, fkt_uid, fkt_name = fkt_nm, fkt_instat = fkt_instat...15) %>%
  # lets also manually move Marovaka to Marovovonana bc its two neighbors moved to that fs
  rbind(data.frame(fs_uid = "xt1C9F1Flqu",
                   fkt_uid = "XwLQg8znk5g",
                   fkt_name = "Marovaka",
                   fkt_instat = "303090008")) %>%
  # accented e in fkt names got converted to ? somewhere in the line, fix it
  mutate(fkt_name = gsub("\\?", "é", fkt_name)) %>%
  # add on the fs information
  left_join(sect_filled_v3 %>%
              filter(!is.na(f_or_nf)) %>%
              select(region_uid:fs_ll) %>%
              distinct) %>%
  # add on the fkt information
  left_join(sect_filled %>%
              select(fkt_uid, fkt_instat_orig:transit)) %>%
  rename(fkt_instat_clean = fkt_instat) %>%
  mutate(match_type = "noncontig_fix")
  noncontig_fixes
}
```

::: {.manual-procedure title="Split Coastal Islands And Apply The Final Unlinks"}

The largest polygon remains mainland except for `MG71713253004`, where the
smallest part is separated as in the source. The `_A` lookup extension and
new assignment rows are updated together. The final review first unlinks old
clinic assignments, appends the new rows with missing population, and then
refreshes geometry with the legacy old-PCODE fallback.

```{r}
s5_sectorization_island_assignments_df <- {
  ocha_map <- s5_fkt_code_lookup_initial_df
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 666–672.
  island_fixes <- data.frame(fkt_instat = c("713151001", "713151004",
                                            "713232005", "713254003",
                                            "713253004", "713010004"),
                             fs_uid = c("Z0mzcQCqySd", "Z0mzcQCqySd",
                                        "Zmgnljl5frE", "yPSYALQxVv2",
                                        "yPSYALQxVv2", "wnWoQcrvINJ")) %>%
    left_join(ocha_map %>% select(fkt_instat = ADM4C_BNGRC, ADM4_PCODE))
  island_fixes
}
```

The coastal split retains the literal legacy expression: area ranks are
computed per feature, while the special-code comparison uses the maximum
rank across the six features. In the archived inputs, that feature has three
parts and the global maximum rank is three. This distinction matters if the
source geometry is replaced; the split audit records each part explicitly.

```{r}
s5_fkt_shapes_final_sf <- {
  fkt_shape <- s5_fkt_shapes_initial_sf
  island_fixes <- s5_sectorization_island_assignments_df
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 674–700.
  fkt_shape <- rbind(fkt_shape %>%
                       filter(ADM4_PCODE %in% c(island_fixes$ADM4_PCODE) == FALSE),
                     fkt_shape %>%
                       filter(ADM4_PCODE %in% c(island_fixes$ADM4_PCODE)) %>%
                       mutate(row_id = seq_len(n())) %>%
                       sf::st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
                       mutate(area = sf::st_area(geometry)) %>%
                       mutate(area_rank = rank(-area), # biggest is rank 1, smallest is max rank
                              .by = row_id) %>%
                       # for groups 1-3, 5 the largest shape is mainland and other islands can go together
                       # for group 4, smallest island goes separate, larger island can stay with mainland
                       # for 5, i think the land is bigger, its the second element when its cast
                       mutate(mainland = ifelse(ADM4_PCODE != "MG71713253004", area_rank == 1, area_rank != max(area_rank))) %>%
                       select(-starts_with("area")) %>%
                       # merge the mainland and non-mainland pieces
                       summarise(across(!geometry, unique),
                                 geometry = sf::st_union(geometry),
                                 .by = c(row_id, mainland)) %>%
                       select(-row_id) %>%
                       # if its the mainland, leave the name and pcode, if its non-mainlan, add a letter to the name and pcode
                       mutate(ADM4_EN = ifelse(mainland,
                                               ADM4_EN,
                                               paste0(ADM4_EN, "_A")),
                              ADM4_PCODE = ifelse(mainland,
                                                  ADM4_PCODE,
                                                  paste0(ADM4_PCODE, "_A"))) %>%
                       select(-mainland))
  fkt_shape
}
```

```{r}
  sect_filled_v4 <- as.data.frame(s5_sectorization_islands_fixed_sf) %>% select(-geometry, -ADM4_PCODE)
  ocha_map <- s5_fkt_code_lookup_final_df
  noncontig_fixes2 <- s5_sectorization_final_reassignment_reviews_df
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 745–752.
  sect_filled_v4 <- sect_filled_v4 %>%
    left_join(ocha_map %>% select(ADM4C_BNGRC, ADM4_PCODE),
              by = c("fkt_instat_clean" = "ADM4C_BNGRC")) %>%
    left_join(noncontig_fixes2 %>% transmute(ADM4_PCODE, old_fs_uid, unmatch = T),
              by = c("ADM4_PCODE", "fs_uid" = "old_fs_uid")) %>%
    mutate(across(c(fkt_instat_orig, fkt_instat_clean, match_type, ADM4_PCODE),
                  ~ifelse(is.na(unmatch), .x, NA))) %>%
    select(-unmatch)
  s5_healthshed_refresh_fn(sect_filled_v4, s5_fkt_code_lookup_final_df, s5_fkt_shapes_final_sf, fallback = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
s5_sectorization_final_reassignment_rows_df <- {
  noncontig_fixes2 <- s5_sectorization_final_reassignment_reviews_df
  sect_filled_v4 <- as.data.frame(s5_sectorization_final_unlinked_sf)
  ocha_map <- s5_fkt_code_lookup_final_df
  # Pinned stage 5, lines 755–768.
  noncontig_fixes2 <- noncontig_fixes2 %>%
    rename_with(~gsub("^new_", "", .x)) %>%
    select(-old_fs_uid, -fs_name) %>%
    left_join(sect_filled_v4 %>%
                select(region_uid:fs_ll) %>%
                filter(!is.na(region_uid)) %>%
                distinct,
              by = c("fs_uid")) %>%
    left_join(ocha_map %>% select(ADM4_PCODE, ADM4_EN,
                                  fkt_instat_clean = ADM4C_BNGRC)) %>%
    rename(fkt_name = ADM4_EN) %>%
    mutate(fkt_uid = "none", fkt_instat_orig = NA,
           fkt_pop_2022 = NA, distance_csb_fkt = NA, transit = NA,
           match_type = "noncontig_fix2")
  noncontig_fixes2
}
```

```{r}
s5_sectorization_2022_clean_sf <- {

                 s5_sectorization_final_reassignment_rows_df)
```

::: {.manual-procedure title="Retain Audits And Review Plots Without Publishing Protected Data"}

The audit reports coverage and population at every major round. Historical
counts are comparison observations, not universal assertions. Plot-list
targets contain clinic diagnostics for authorized review and are never
rendered into this manual. True polygon-part counts are audited separately
from the literal legacy `n_shape` field.

```{r}
s5_healthshed_audit_fn <- function(sectorizations, shapes) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(sectorizations), function(round) {
    x <- sectorizations[[round]]
    tibble::tibble(round = round, rows = nrow(x), clinics = n_distinct(x$fs_uid, na.rm = TRUE),
      population = sum(x$fkt_pop_2022, na.rm = TRUE),
      unmatched_assignment_rows = sum(is.na(x$fkt_instat_clean)),
      unmatched_polygons = sum(!shapes$ADM4_PCODE %in% x$ADM4_PCODE),
      empty_assignment_geometries = sum(sf::st_is_empty(x)),
      unknown_pcodes = sum(!is.na(x$ADM4_PCODE) & !x$ADM4_PCODE %in% shapes$ADM4_PCODE))
  }))
}
s5_healthshed_assignment_audit_df <- s5_healthshed_audit_fn(list(
  initial = s5_sectorization_contiguity_filtered_sf, v2 = s5_sectorization_reviewed_v2_sf,
  v3 = s5_sectorization_commune_filled_sf, final = s5_sectorization_2022_clean_sf), s5_fkt_shapes_final_sf)
s5_healthshed_clinic_audit_df <- s5_healthshed_clinic_final_sf %>%
  mutate(polygon_parts = lengths(sf::st_geometry(s5_healthshed_clinic_final_sf)),
         empty_geometry = sf::st_is_empty(s5_healthshed_clinic_final_sf)) %>% sf::st_drop_geometry()
s5_fkt_split_audit_df <- bind_rows(lapply(c("source", "initial", "final"), function(stage) {
  x <- switch(stage, source = s5_fkt_shapes_valid_sf, initial = s5_fkt_shapes_initial_sf, final = s5_fkt_shapes_final_sf)
  split_codes <- c("MG71717150005", s5_sectorization_island_assignments_df$ADM4_PCODE)
  selected <- x %>% filter(sub("(_A|[AB])$", "", ADM4_PCODE) %in% split_codes)
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(selected)), function(i) {
    parts <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_cast(sf::st_geometry(selected[i, ]), "POLYGON"))
    bounds <- t(vapply(parts, function(part) sf::st_bbox(part), numeric(4)))
    tibble::tibble(stage = stage, ADM4_PCODE = selected$ADM4_PCODE[[i]], part = seq_along(parts),
      area_m2 = as.numeric(sf::st_area(parts)), xmin = bounds[,1], ymin = bounds[,2],
      xmax = bounds[,3], ymax = bounds[,4], wkt = sf::st_as_text(parts), crs_wkt = sf::st_crs(x)$wkt)
  }))
}))
s5_healthshed_review_plots_fn <- function(sheds, assignments, multipart = FALSE) {
  selected <- if (multipart) filter(sheds, n_components == 1, n_shape > 1) else filter(sheds, n_components > 1)
  plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(selected)), function(i) {
    focus <- selected[i, ]
    nearby <- sf::st_filter(sheds, sf::st_as_sfc(sf::st_bbox(focus)))
    cells <- filter(assignments, fs_uid %in% nearby$fs_uid)
    plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::geom_sf(data = nearby, ggplot2::aes(fill = fs_uid)) +
      ggplot2::geom_sf(data = cells, fill = NA, colour = "grey35", linetype = "dotted") +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = MetBrewer::met.brewer("Renoir", nrow(nearby))) +
      ggplot2::ggtitle(paste(focus$fs_uid, focus$fs_name, focus$district_name, sep = ": ")) +
      ggplot2::coord_sf(xlim = extendrange(sf::st_bbox(focus)[c(1, 3)], f = 0.5),
                        ylim = extendrange(sf::st_bbox(focus)[c(2, 4)], f = 0.5)) + ggplot2::theme_void()
    locations <- sf::st_drop_geometry(nearby) %>%
      filter(!is.na(fs_ll), grepl("^POINT[[:space:]]*[(]", fs_ll))
    if (nrow(locations)) {
      locations <- sf::st_sf(locations, geometry = sf::st_as_sfc(locations$fs_ll, crs = sf::st_crs(sheds)))
      plot <- plot + ggplot2::geom_sf(data = locations, colour = "grey15", size = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE)
    }
    plot
  })
  setNames(plots, selected$fs_uid)
}
s5_healthshed_clinic_noncontiguous_review_list <- s5_healthshed_review_plots_fn(
  s5_healthshed_clinic_final_sf, s5_sectorization_2022_clean_sf)
s5_healthshed_clinic_multipart_review_list <- s5_healthshed_review_plots_fn(
  s5_healthshed_clinic_final_sf, s5_sectorization_2022_clean_sf, multipart = TRUE)
```

::: {.manual-procedure title="Expose Spatial Handoffs And Nonspatial Parquet Products"}

Pages 24–25 consume the final sectorization and healthshed `sf` objects
directly, retaining full field names and geometry. Only explicit nonspatial
assignment/audit exports are written below. No shapefile field truncation or
new spatial interchange format is introduced.

```{r}
s5_healthshed_write_table_fn <- function(x, path) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  duckplyr::compute_parquet(duckplyr::as_duckdb_tibble(as.data.frame(x)), path)
  path
}
```

```{r}
#| format: file
s5_sectorization_2022_clean_parquet <- s5_healthshed_write_table_fn(
  sf::st_drop_geometry(s5_sectorization_2022_clean_sf), here::here("data/intermediates/healthsheds/sectorization2022_clean.parquet"))
s5_healthshed_assignment_audit_parquet <- s5_healthshed_write_table_fn(
  s5_healthshed_assignment_audit_df, here::here("data/intermediates/healthsheds/assignment_audit.parquet"))
```

::: {.manual-check title="Verify Rules Before Building Research Products"}

The synthetic suite extracts helpers and target expressions from this page,
compares legacy behavior on controlled geometry, and validates the targets
graph without building targets. Run it before the stage-5 build. Full-data parity is an explicit
comparison against the most recent archived data; synthetic tests alone do not prove it.
The [baseline selection](mapping/legacy-pipeline-map.qmd#most-recent-archived-data-comparison-baseline),
loaded with `dget(here::here("src", "archived-comparison-baseline.R"))`, selects
`sectorization_member` and `healthsheds_member` from `archive_zip`. These are
October 2024 products; no newer replacements were found in the staged sources.

```sh
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript tests/check-healthshed-rules.R
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript tests/check-data-storage-convention.R
python3 tests/check-manual-structure.py
```

**Current scope (2026-11-08): inspect output shape before proceeding.**
The initial pages' shape checks appear to pass according to the researcher.
Run the following plain R examples in order after S5 completes; they read
existing products and build no targets. Results stay in the authorized
session, outside rendered HTML. The archived healthsheds are RDS and can be
compared directly. Archived sectorization is Feather; that comparison is
deferred, with no Feather reader added.

```r
# Shape check: healthsheds-setup
archived_baseline <- dget(here::here("src", "archived-comparison-baseline.R"))
read_fn <- targets::tar_read(s3_dictionary_archive_read_fn)
old_healthsheds <- read_fn(here::here(archived_baseline$archive_zip),
  archived_baseline$healthsheds_member, readRDS)
new_healthsheds <- targets::tar_read(s5_healthshed_clinic_final_sf)
new_sectorization <- targets::tar_read(s5_sectorization_2022_clean_sf)
```

**Healthshed dimensions, UID coverage, and geometry structure side by side.**
Here `columns` includes geometry; `attribute_columns` excludes all `sfc`
columns. Geometry validity is reported separately from empty geometry.
`difference` is current minus archived; equal counts do not establish equal
polygons or clinic memberships.

```r
# Shape check: healthsheds-dimensions
healthshed_shape <- function(x) {
  valid <- sf::st_is_valid(x)
  tibble::tibble(
    rows = nrow(x), columns = length(names(x)),
    attribute_columns = sum(!vapply(x, inherits, logical(1), what = "sfc")),
    clinics = dplyr::n_distinct(x$fs_uid, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_uids = sum(is.na(x$fs_uid) | x$fs_uid == ""),
    empty_geometries = sum(sf::st_is_empty(x), na.rm = TRUE),
    invalid_geometries = sum(!valid, na.rm = TRUE),
    unknown_validity = sum(is.na(valid))
  )
}
dplyr::bind_rows(
  `most recent archived data` = healthshed_shape(old_healthsheds),
  `current pipeline` = healthshed_shape(new_healthsheds), .id = "source"
) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-source, names_to = "metric", values_to = "count") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = count) |>
  dplyr::mutate(difference = `current pipeline` - `most recent archived data`) |>
  print(n = Inf)
tibble::tibble(
  source = c("most recent archived data", "current pipeline"),
  crs = c(sf::st_crs(old_healthsheds)$input, sf::st_crs(new_healthsheds)$input)
)
```

```r
# Shape check: healthsheds-schema
dplyr::bind_rows(
  `most recent archived data` = tibble::tibble(position = seq_along(names(old_healthsheds)), column = names(old_healthsheds)),
  `current pipeline` = tibble::tibble(position = seq_along(names(new_healthsheds)), column = names(new_healthsheds)),
  .id = "source"
) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = column) |>
  dplyr::arrange(position) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```r
# Shape check: healthsheds-types
dplyr::bind_rows(
  `most recent archived data` = tibble::tibble(type = as.character(sf::st_geometry_type(old_healthsheds))),
  `current pipeline` = tibble::tibble(type = as.character(sf::st_geometry_type(new_healthsheds))),
  .id = "source"
) |>
  dplyr::count(source, type, name = "rows") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = rows, values_fill = 0L) |>
  dplyr::mutate(difference = `current pipeline` - `most recent archived data`) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

**Current sectorization shape and assignment-method counts.** Assignment rows
can share a clinic or FKT; these counts do not impose uniqueness on those
fields. The column listing includes the geometry column.

```r
# Shape check: sectorization-dimensions
tibble::tibble(rows = nrow(new_sectorization), columns = length(names(new_sectorization)))
tibble::tibble(position = seq_along(names(new_sectorization)), column = names(new_sectorization)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
sf::st_drop_geometry(new_sectorization) |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rows = dplyr::n(), clinics = dplyr::n_distinct(fs_uid, na.rm = TRUE),
    assigned_fkt_codes = dplyr::n_distinct(fkt_instat_clean, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_fkt_codes = sum(is.na(fkt_instat_clean) | fkt_instat_clean == "")
  )
sf::st_drop_geometry(new_sectorization) |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::count(match_type, name = "rows", sort = TRUE) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```
